articles.title: BTS Pulls a Bathroom Prank to Hype Their New Song!
articles.summary: BTS took out fake newspaper ads showing them at urinals! The silly stunt is for their new single "NORMAL," out Friday. It's all a joke to get fans excited.

articles.title: Mysterious Metal Balls from Space Wash Up on a Beach!
articles.summary: Six shiny metal balls, called "space balls," washed up on Forrest Beach in Australia. They're actually fuel tanks from a rocket that fell from orbit. No aliens—just space junk!

articles.title: Ex-PlayStation Boss Says He Misses the Old Xbox Rivalry!
articles.summary: Shawn Layden, who used to run PlayStation, wants Xbox to be strong again. He says the old console wars made games better and more exciting for everyone.
